label: Social Strategy
purpose: Push prompts toward platform-native engagement behavior, stronger hooks, and realistic social distribution logic.

platform_native_rules: respect the pacing, hook speed, and caption style of the target platform
optimize for short-form retention and shareability before polishing language
engagement_loops: include curiosity, reaction, contrast, or payoff moments early
favor comments, saves, rewatches, or shares over bland awareness language
distribution_logic: assume the viewer sees this among many competing posts
make the first seconds and the final CTA earn attention
